title: Historical Myth-Making, Border Fortress Mentality, and Tragic Destiny

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian historical consciousness is defined by defensive and sacrificial metaphors. The *végvár* (border fortress) and *védőbástya* (bulwark of Western Christendom against the Ottoman Empire) present, in the national tradition, Hungary as an outpost sacrificing itself for Europe.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: *Balsors* (ill fate, immortalized in the National Anthem) and *megmaradás* (tenacious survival against demographic and political extinction) are recurring images in the Hungarian national self-image.
